findings.was: 40 N/mm passes, 10 N/mm fails, no measured value
findings.now: Acceptance band 40-120 N/mm per roller at the 6 mm squeeze, nominal 80. Receive: 10 N/mm 9/12, 20 N/mm 12/12, 40-160 N/mm 108/108 (tread mu 0.3-1.0). Eject: 10-160 N/mm captured, 240 N/mm 0/8 (stalls). No supplier or community source publishes a 2 in compliant wheel's radial stiffness, so the wheel count and durometer are set on the bench: 240-720 N at 6 mm on the installed roller.

findings.was: must self-lock against 4.10 N m; reducer unselected
findings.now: The worm is removed. Drive: REV NEO 550 through a REV MAXPlanetary 4:1 x 3:1 x 3:1 (36:1, 1/2 in hex socket), with a powered position hold. The worm stalls on treads of 110 N/mm and above (0/4), which would have capped the tread band at about 80; the planetary ejects 480/480 at 9-13 V. Lower ratios overspeed the roll-off, so 36:1 is the ratio. Disabled, the back-drivable nip still seats 4/4 receives and holds 18/18 sled pulses. Peak shaft torque 8.956 N m against a 180 N m class gearbox rating; the hold reaches its 30 A limit on the receive impact.

findings.was: layout-001 relied on the worm's self-lock; with the worm removed, 18 disabled sled pulses were the only evidence
findings.status: closed by trial and a control setting; bench gate G7
findings.now: With the main power off the gearbox coasts and the pipe is held by the tread squeeze: 24/24 required cases retained over 40-160 N/mm (a 1.5 g stop for 0.5 s and an 8 g, 50 ms hit, main power off and brake idle mode), largest travel into the nip 3.79 mm. At 40 N/mm with the power off: sustained 6 g kept, 8 g lost; 50 ms hit 16 g kept, 24 g lost. Static push-through 71.8 N at 40 N/mm against a 14.2 N stop load. Control: rollers decoupled on a 20 N/mm tread lose the pipe at 8 g. Handoff requirement: the nip motor controller's idle mode is brake, so the windings are shorted whenever the robot is disabled with the controller powered. Coast idle mode is not accepted. Brake idle mode is not credited with the breaker off, where the squeeze alone holds. It holds further while the controller is powered (16 g kept, 24 g lost for a 50 ms hit at 40 N/mm) but is not credited with the breaker off. Limit: at 40 N/mm with the power off the pipe is pushed through by 8 g sustained or a 24 g hit; it then rolls out over the lip. No lock, detent or gate is added.

findings.was: 0.543 s slowest, 0.145-0.689 s with contact stiffness, against 1.0 s (cycle) and 0.5 s (bench target)
findings.status: closed by a control change; bench gate G1
findings.now: The dwell is the captive time: flap closed behind the pipe, 0.093-0.292 s after it passes the flap, plus 50 ms for the flap switch: 0.342 s against 1.0 s. Seat time is now 0.093-1.216 s (the receive starts on the station chute and rebounds) and no longer holds the robot: leaving 50 ms after the flap closes, at 3 and 6 m/s2, retains 24/24 and the pipe is seated within 0.103 s of the stop. Without the flap the same run loses the pipe (0/2).

findings.was: stop, hinge, lip stiffness and tip load unsized; the lip is 24.5 mm ahead of the bumper all match
findings.status: closed by a design change; bench gate G6
findings.now: The lip stays 100 mm out because the reach is earned: a lip inside the bumper face captures only 3/8 at 100 mm stand-off. A frontal hit on a rigid stop would bend the 1/8 in polycarbonate to 94 MPa (yield 62), so the deployed stop is sprung: 6 N m preload, 31.2 deg over-travel, which folds the tip behind the bumper face at 22 MPa. Landing stress 13.4 MPa, static sag 0.99 mm, deploy 0.172 s. The over-travel swing is a checked case.

findings.was: each plate bears on 20 mm of stringer; bolt pattern and bending unsized
findings.now: Two 10-32 bolts per plate 45 mm apart: 1302 N bolt tension from the receive impact against 4500 N pull-out (margin 3.46); plate bending 15.4 MPa. Steel 1/2 in hex shafts: 1.1974 mm mid-span at the band maximum against a 1.5 mm allowance (aluminium would deflect 2.9 times as far).

findings.was: seated-pipe sensor and lip switch proposed but undesigned
findings.status: closed in this layout; bench gate G5
findings.now: Selected and placed as blocks: Adafruit 2168 break beam through windows in both side plates (blocked for pipe centres X 296-333 mm), REV-31-1462 magnetic switches for flap-closed and lip-deployed, and a CTRE CANrange reading the trough face.

findings.was: ruling open; reef zone unregistered; zone sensing unspecified
findings.status: closed by ruling and interlock; bench gate G5
findings.now: Reef zone tape is 355.6 mm outside the reef face (final manual 5.2: 93.5 in zone, 65.5 in reef). The eject is interlocked on a reef range of 100 mm stand-off or less, which puts the bumper at least 255.6 mm inside the zone. The trough lip's offset from the reef face is the one unread dimension; it cannot exceed the margin.

The first pipe is a fixture of every eject case. Control: in the same section the second eject is captured only 24/180 times, so the second trip needs each dock within +/-70 mm laterally (pipe ends 169.4 mm apart at nominal docks). G4 measures the scatter.

findings.was: not a registered fixture; receive trials started on the robot's inlet at an energy estimate
findings.now: The station chute is a registered fixture and the receive trial starts on it: rest release leaves the sill at 1.479-1.806 m/s and peaks at 2.435-2.955 m/s before the flap (layout-001 assumed 2.22-2.47). Pushed feeds to 3.604 m/s still seat (18/24). The pipe's contact with the chute is a qualified intended interface. A flared hood lead-in was added for the bounce the drop produces.

findings.was: every mission case was a straight or circular stroke drawn from geometry, pinned to a trial
findings.now: Every receive and eject case is a stroke between two poses of a solved trace (receive-mission, eject-nominal), within 10 mm of it, with the flap angle from the same trace and the trace time on each frame. Only the lip deploy and the park drive are prescribed, and say so.

findings.was: weak-pack bus 9.28 V against 9.0 V; 48.34 of 52.16 kg
findings.now: Weak-pack minimum bus 9.12 V against 9.0 V; heavy inspection estimate 49.78 of 52.16 kg. The steel shafts and the planetary add mass; the hold adds 5 A to the carry and 30 A to the docked receive.

findings.was: B (no lip) dock window ends between 75 and 100 mm
findings.now: Layout-002 does not re-run the lip-less B launch. The lip-removed isolation is its nearest evidence and B stays a fallback only in the sense of the evaluation.
